item.title: WATCH- Ayush Mhatre, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and India U19 team receive hero’s welcome after U19 World Cup 2026 win
item.description: The Indian U19 team returned home to screaming fans, media, and a hero’s welcome with family members waiting for them on Sunday, February 8, 2026. India won a record-extending sixth title in Harare, Zimbabwe, on Friday, defeating England by 100 runs. India, led by Ayush Mhatre, scored a remarkable 411/9, with 14-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashing an outstanding 175 off 80 deliveries. item.description: The Indian team has arrived in Delhi for their second T20 World Cup 2026 game, which will be played against Namibia on February 12, 2026.
